title: canthium telidosma
intro: Canthium telidosma, commonly known as the Telosma vine, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine, valued for its health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce blood pressure, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer activities. The bioactive constituents of Canthium telidosma include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
